title: Unmatched Badge Scan
brief: Our office gates log a badge id every time someone passes through. Everyone scans once on the way in and once on the way out, except one visitor who slipped out without scanning, so their badge id appears only once in the day's log.
Implement findUnpairedBadge(nums), where nums holds the day's badge ids in scan order, and return the id that appears only once.
